{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|Your Highness, there's nothing more we can do tonight. The shield doors must be closed.|Major Bren Derlin|<ref name="Episode 5">{{Film|V}}</ref>}}
'''Shield doors''' were employed at [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] to seal the interior of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] base from [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth's]] sub-zero temperatures. '''Shield doors''' were used widely throughout the galaxy. Created by the inventors of the [[Hush-98 comlink/Legends|Hush-98 comlink]], this technology was reliable, and took up very little amounts of energy to run, making it very efficient.

The '''Shield Doors '''used a thermal-capturing technology that allowed heat to be built up and distributed throughout [[Echo Base]].
